tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab pa skor bdun las: dbang chen rta mgrin yang phyung dmar po bzhugs so:

ྈྈ dbang chen he ru ka la 'dud: de nyid tshul bzhin sgrub pa ni: sngon 'gro'i las rim gzhan du shes: dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom: hrī: rang rig hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: 'byung ba rim brtsegs srung ba'i mkhar: dbus su bh+rūm̐ yig las byung ba'i: rin chen gzhal yas khang pa ni: gru bzhi rta babs rgyan rnams rdzogs: nang ni dur khrod rol pa'i rgyan: dbus su rdo rje'i tog dang ldan: phyi nang zang thal 'od du 'bar: nang du 'khor lo rim pa gnyis: pad+ma nyi zla klu dbang steng: hrīḥlas dbang chen rta skad 'tsher: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing spyan dgu bsgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: dbu skra gyen brdzes rta yi dbu: i ha'i sgra sgrog srid gsum sdud: g.yas gsum ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug: g.yon gsum bhan dril lcags kyu bsnams: yum ni pad+ma gzi ldan ma: kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud: dur khrod chas rdzogs me klong bzhugs: g.yas g.yon byi la pu shud mgo: kha ṭ+wāṃ lcags kyu thod khrag 'dzin: phyogs bzhir 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: dbang chen dkar ser dmar ljang mdangs: rigs bzhi'i yum 'khril rang rtags 'dzin: phyogs mtshams 'khor lor zil gnon brgyad: yab yum rgyan rdzogs rang rtags 'dzin: sgo bzhir 'jigs pa'i gdong can bzhi: lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril bu bsnams: gzhan yang dbang gi bka' nyan tshogs: ma lus rje dang 'bangs bzhin gsal: sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang rdzogs shog: oṃ pad+mān ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dbang mchog ma lus skur ba dang:

ye shes brtan par mdzad du gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa pa ri bā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dza: hūm̐: dur khrod rab 'jigs dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'bar ba'i gdan mchog yangs pa la: gnyis su med par bzhugs nas kyang: dngos grub chen po bstsal du gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: rang rig rgyal po he ru ka: khams gsum zil gnon dbang gi rgyal: gdug pa kun 'joms ye shes lha: snying rje che la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti tsa ho: hūm̐: rang rig klong las shar ba yi: dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa'i: kun bzang mchod sprin chen pos mchod: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hūm̐: dug lnga bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: nang khrol klad zhag rkang la sogs: dug lnga skyes grol mchod pa che: dpal chen lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba'i: bde ba chen po chags pa che: dga' ba'i ro yis nam mkha' gang: dpal chen lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: ma hā su kha pū dza ho: hūm̐: rmad du byung ba'i dam rdzas ni: dug lnga rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: ye shes lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi 'di: dpal chen lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: hūm̐: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: dbyings kyi bhan+dha chen por bsgral: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa che: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: ye shes rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin ni: 'dod yon gtor ma bsam mi khyab: mnyes pa'i mchod pa ci yang gsal: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: gsang ba byang chub sems kyi rgyun: bde ba chen po skyed pa'i rgyu: de nyid rnam par 'phel ba'i phyir: bde chen sbyor ba'i mchod pa 'bul:

ma hā mu drā bhañdza mok+ṣa ma hā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta pū dza ho: hūm̐: ma rig gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: rig pa ye shes mtshon gyis bsgral: ye shes rol pa'i bsgral mchod 'di: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: ru dra mā ra ya phaṭa kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: gdod ma nyid kyi dbyings nyid las: mchod bya mchod yul dmigs su med: ma bcos klong yangs chen por gnas: ka dag chen po'i ngang du mchod: ma hā dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: hūm̐: 'jigs pa'i sku ni gar dgu ldan: nam mkha'i mtha' klas mnyam pa nyid: 'bar ba'i gar stabs ci yang snang: rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'jigs pa'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrog: stong pa nyid kyi sgra gdangs ni: yan lag drug cu dang ldan zhing: rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dmigs pa med pa'i ye shes ni: snying rje chen po dang ldan zhing: 'bar ba'i thugs ni mi bzad gtum: rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor gyi dbang chen pho nya ni: ye shes dang ni las las grub: dpal gyi bka' las mi 'da' ba: ye shes 'khor la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas rta skad sgrog pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs ma lus pa: byin rlabs dbang bskur chen po stsol: dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'dus shig: dbang chen bka' las ma 'da' zhig: i ha ha: hūm̐: ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: myur du 'dus shig phrin las mdzod: zhi rgyas dbang drag so sor sgrubs: dbang chen bka' las ma 'da' zhig: i ha ha: hūm̐: nga ni dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal: khams gsum kun la 'gran zla med: dbang chen rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams rdul du brlag: i ha ha: bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan gyis: oṃ pad+mān ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: las kyi sbyor ba gsum ldan pas: pad+ma ḍā ki nī kha la ro sha kha la ro sha ma ma sarba bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: rjes kyi bya ba thams cad ni:

spyi chings las ni shes par bya: dbang chen 'dus pa'i las byang ni: snying por dril te khyad par 'phags: phyi rabs pa yi don du bkod: las can zhig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈ lha sras rnam 'phrul gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pas yel phug nam mkha' mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'i zangs shog dmar po'i ngos las 'beb rim bzhin du/ pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs kyi gdan sa chen po'i gan+dho lar bris pa dbang chen rol pa'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// //
